model.shopify.shopify_gql__refunds.description: Each record represents a refund transaction. Aggregates line item financials to the refund grain and includes discrepancy adjustments for accurate reconciliation. When the `shopify_gql_using_return` variable is enabled, return context and shipping fee columns are included.

unique_key.name: unique_key
unique_key.description: Unique key representing a refund transaction. Hashed on 'refund_id' and 'source_relation'.

refund_id.name: refund_id
refund_id.description: The ID of the refund.

return_id.name: return_id
return_id.description: The ID of the return associated with this refund, if applicable.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: The ID of the order the refund belongs to.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.description: The ID of the customer who placed the original order.

email.name: email
email.description: The email address of the customer who placed the original order.

order_channel.name: order_channel
order_channel.description: The channel where the original order was placed (e.g. web, pos).

order_created_at.name: order_created_at
order_created_at.description: The timestamp when the original order was created.

refund_created_at.name: refund_created_at
refund_created_at.description: The timestamp when the refund was created.

refund_updated_at.name: refund_updated_at
refund_updated_at.description: The timestamp when the refund was last updated.

days_to_refund.name: days_to_refund
days_to_refund.description: Number of days between the original order creation date and the refund creation date.

refund_note.name: refund_note
refund_note.description: An optional note attached to the refund by the merchant or staff.

staff_user_id.name: staff_user_id
staff_user_id.description: The ID of the staff member who processed the refund.

shopify_total_refunded_shop_amount.name: shopify_total_refunded_shop_amount
shopify_total_refunded_shop_amount.description: Shopify's pre-computed total refund amount in shop currency. Use for reconciliation against the line item sum (total_refunded_shop_amount).

shopify_total_refunded_pres_amount.name: shopify_total_refunded_pres_amount
shopify_total_refunded_pres_amount.description: Shopify's pre-computed total refund amount in presentment currency.

total_refunded_pres_currency_code.name: total_refunded_pres_currency_code
total_refunded_pres_currency_code.description: The presentment currency code for the refund totals.

count_refund_line_items.name: count_refund_line_items
count_refund_line_items.description: The number of line items included in this refund.

total_quantity_refunded.name: total_quantity_refunded
total_quantity_refunded.description: The total quantity of items refunded across all line items.

subtotal_shop_amount.name: subtotal_shop_amount
subtotal_shop_amount.description: The sum of line item subtotals for this refund, before tax, in shop currency.

total_tax_shop_amount.name: total_tax_shop_amount
total_tax_shop_amount.description: The total tax refunded across all line items in shop currency.

total_refunded_shop_amount.name: total_refunded_shop_amount
total_refunded_shop_amount.description: The total amount refunded across all line items including tax in shop currency. Equal to subtotal_shop_amount + total_tax_shop_amount.

subtotal_pres_amount.name: subtotal_pres_amount
subtotal_pres_amount.description: The sum of line item subtotals for this refund, before tax, in presentment currency.

total_tax_pres_amount.name: total_tax_pres_amount
total_tax_pres_amount.description: The total tax refunded across all line items in presentment currency.

total_refunded_pres_amount.name: total_refunded_pres_amount
total_refunded_pres_amount.description: The total amount refunded across all line items including tax in presentment currency. Equal to subtotal_pres_amount + total_tax_pres_amount.

quantity_restocked.name: quantity_restocked
quantity_restocked.description: The total quantity of items physically restocked as part of this refund.

count_restocked_line_items.name: count_restocked_line_items
count_restocked_line_items.description: The number of line items that were restocked as part of this refund.

refund_discrepancy_tax_shop_amount.name: refund_discrepancy_tax_shop_amount
refund_discrepancy_tax_shop_amount.description: The tax portion of the discrepancy adjustment in shop currency.

refund_discrepancy_pres_amount.name: refund_discrepancy_pres_amount
refund_discrepancy_pres_amount.description: The discrepancy adjustment in presentment currency.

refund_discrepancy_tax_pres_amount.name: refund_discrepancy_tax_pres_amount
refund_discrepancy_tax_pres_amount.description: The tax portion of the discrepancy adjustment in presentment currency.

has_return.name: has_return
has_return.description: Whether this refund was initiated via a return request. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_name.name: return_name
return_name.description: The name of the return associated with this refund. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_status.description: The status of the return (e.g. OPEN, CLOSED). Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_shipping_fee_pres_amount.name: return_shipping_fee_pres_amount

return_shipping_fee_pres_currency_codes.name: return_shipping_fee_pres_currency_codes
return_shipping_fee_pres_currency_codes.description: Comma-separated list of presentment currency codes for return shipping fees. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

model.shopify.shopify_gql__refunds.raw_code:
{{ config(enabled=var('shopify_api', 'rest') == var('shopify_api_override','graphql')) }}

with refunds as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__refund') }}

), orders as (

    select
        order_id,
        source_relation,
        customer_id,
        email,
        source_name,
        created_timestamp as order_created_at
    from {{ ref('int_shopify_gql__order') }}

), order_adjustment_aggregates as (

    select
        refund_id,
        source_relation,
        sum(amount_shop) as refund_discrepancy_shop_amount,
        sum(tax_amount_shop) as refund_discrepancy_tax_shop_amount,
        sum(amount_pres) as refund_discrepancy_pres_amount,
        sum(tax_amount_pres) as refund_discrepancy_tax_pres_amount
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order_adjustment') }}
    where lower(reason) = 'refund_discrepancy'
    group by 1, 2

), refund_line_aggregates as (

    select
        refund_id,
        source_relation,
        count(*) as count_refund_line_items,
        sum(quantity) as total_quantity_refunded,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_shop_amount, 0)) as subtotal_shop_amount,
        sum(coalesce(total_tax_shop_amount, 0)) as total_tax_shop_amount,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_shop_amount, 0)) + sum(coalesce(total_tax_shop_amount, 0)) as total_refunded_shop_amount,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_pres_amount, 0)) as subtotal_pres_amount,
        sum(coalesce(total_tax_pres_amount, 0)) as total_tax_pres_amount,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_pres_amount, 0)) + sum(coalesce(total_tax_pres_amount, 0)) as total_refunded_pres_amount,
        sum(case when restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock') then quantity else 0 end) as quantity_restocked,
        count(case when restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock') then 1 end) as count_restocked_line_items
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order_line_refund') }}
    group by 1, 2

{% if var('shopify_gql_using_return', False) %}
), returns as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__return') }}

), return_shipping_fee_aggregates as (

    select
        return_id,
        source_relation,
        sum(amount_shop_amount) as return_shipping_fee_shop_amount,
        sum(amount_pres_amount) as return_shipping_fee_pres_amount,
        {{ fivetran_utils.string_agg("distinct cast(amount_pres_currency_code as " ~ dbt.type_string() ~ ")", "', '") }} as return_shipping_fee_pres_currency_codes
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__return_shipping_fee') }}
    group by 1, 2
{% endif %}

), joined as (

    select
        -- identity / keys
        refunds.unique_key,
        refunds.refund_id,
        refunds.source_relation,
        refunds.return_id,
        refunds.order_id,

        -- order context
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.email,
        orders.source_name as order_channel,
        orders.order_created_at,

        -- timing
        refunds.created_at as refund_created_at,
        refunds.updated_at as refund_updated_at,
        {{ dbt.datediff('cast(orders.order_created_at as date)', 'cast(refunds.created_at as date)', 'day') }} as days_to_refund,

        -- refund metadata
        refunds.note as refund_note,
        refunds.user_id as staff_user_id,

        -- shopify-reported header total (for reconciliation against line item sum)
        refunds.total_refunded_shop_amount as shopify_total_refunded_shop_amount,
        refunds.total_refunded_pres_amount as shopify_total_refunded_pres_amount,
        refunds.total_refunded_pres_currency_code,

        -- line item aggregates (shop currency)

    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."int_shopify_gql__order"

), order_adjustment_aggregates as (

    select
        refund_id,
        source_relation,
        sum(amount_shop) as refund_discrepancy_shop_amount,
        sum(tax_amount_shop) as refund_discrepancy_tax_shop_amount,
        sum(amount_pres) as refund_discrepancy_pres_amount,
        sum(tax_amount_pres) as refund_discrepancy_tax_pres_amount
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."stg_shopify_gql__order_adjustment"
    where lower(reason) = 'refund_discrepancy'
    group by 1, 2

), refund_line_aggregates as (

    select
        refund_id,
        source_relation,
        count(*) as count_refund_line_items,
        sum(quantity) as total_quantity_refunded,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_shop_amount, 0)) as subtotal_shop_amount,
        sum(coalesce(total_tax_shop_amount, 0)) as total_tax_shop_amount,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_shop_amount, 0)) + sum(coalesce(total_tax_shop_amount, 0)) as total_refunded_shop_amount,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_pres_amount, 0)) as subtotal_pres_amount,
        sum(coalesce(total_tax_pres_amount, 0)) as total_tax_pres_amount,
        sum(coalesce(subtotal_pres_amount, 0)) + sum(coalesce(total_tax_pres_amount, 0)) as total_refunded_pres_amount,
        sum(case when restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock') then quantity else 0 end) as quantity_restocked,
        count(case when restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock') then 1 end) as count_restocked_line_items
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."stg_shopify_gql__order_line_refund"
    group by 1, 2


), returns as (

    select *
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."stg_shopify_gql__return"

), return_shipping_fee_aggregates as (

    select
        return_id,
        source_relation,
        sum(amount_shop_amount) as return_shipping_fee_shop_amount,
        sum(amount_pres_amount) as return_shipping_fee_pres_amount,
        
    string_agg(distinct cast(amount_pres_currency_code as TEXT), ', ')

 as return_shipping_fee_pres_currency_codes
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."stg_shopify_gql__return_shipping_fee"
    group by 1, 2

    select
        -- identity / keys
        refunds.unique_key,
        refunds.refund_id,
        refunds.source_relation,
        refunds.return_id,
        refunds.order_id,

        -- order context
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.email,

        orders.order_created_at,

        refunds.created_at as refund_created_at,
        refunds.updated_at as refund_updated_at,

        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.total_refunded_shop_amount, 0) as total_refunded_shop_amount,

        -- line item aggregates (presentment currency)
        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.subtotal_pres_amount, 0) as subtotal_pres_amount,
        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.total_tax_pres_amount, 0) as total_tax_pres_amount,
        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.total_refunded_pres_amount, 0) as total_refunded_pres_amount,

        -- restock summary
        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.quantity_restocked, 0) as quantity_restocked,
        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.count_restocked_line_items, 0) as count_restocked_line_items,
        coalesce(refund_line_aggregates.count_restocked_line_items, 0) > 0 as has_restock,

        -- discrepancy adjustment (difference between sum of line items and actual amount processed)
        order_adjustment_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_shop_amount,
        order_adjustment_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_tax_shop_amount,
        order_adjustment_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_pres_amount,
        order_adjustment_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_tax_pres_amount

        
        -- return context (only when shopify_gql_using_return is enabled)
        , returns.return_id is not null as has_return
        , returns.name as return_name
        , returns.status as return_status
        , returns.decline_reason as return_decline_reason
        , returns.decline_note as return_decline_note

        -- return shipping cost (what merchant charges/absorbs for return shipment)
        , coalesce(return_shipping_fee_aggregates.return_shipping_fee_shop_amount, 0) as return_shipping_fee_shop_amount
        , coalesce(return_shipping_fee_aggregates.return_shipping_fee_pres_amount, 0) as return_shipping_fee_pres_amount
        , return_shipping_fee_aggregates.return_shipping_fee_pres_currency_codes
        

    from refunds
    left join orders
        on refunds.order_id = orders.order_id
        and refunds.source_relation = orders.source_relation
    left join refund_line_aggregates
        on refunds.refund_id = refund_line_aggregates.refund_id

    left join order_adjustment_aggregates

        sum(order_lines.quantity_net_refunds) as quantity_sold_net_refunds,
        sum(order_lines.subtotal_net_refunds) as subtotal_sold_net_refunds,
        min(orders.created_timestamp) as first_order_timestamp,
        max(orders.created_timestamp) as most_recent_order_timestamp,

        sum(coalesce(discount_allocation_agg.discount_allocation_amount, 0)) as product_total_discount,
        sum(order_lines.order_line_tax) as product_total_tax,
        avg(order_lines.quantity) as avg_quantity_per_order_line,
        avg(coalesce(discount_allocation_agg.discount_allocation_amount, 0)) as product_avg_discount_per_order_line,
        avg(order_lines.order_line_tax) as product_avg_tax_per_order_line

    from order_lines
    left join orders
        on order_lines.order_id = orders.order_id
        and order_lines.source_relation = orders.source_relation
    left join discount_allocation_agg
        on order_lines.order_line_id = discount_allocation_agg.order_line_id
        and order_lines.source_relation = discount_allocation_agg.source_relation
    group by 1,2

)

from product_aggregated

model.shopify.shopify_gql__daily_shop.name: shopify_gql__daily_shop

date_day.name: date_day

shop_id.name: shop_id

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the shop.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.description: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

currency.name: currency
currency.description: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop's default currency.

enabled_presentment_currencies.name: enabled_presentment_currencies
enabled_presentment_currencies.description: An array of of enabled currencies (ISO 4217 format) that the shop accepts. Merchants can enable currencies from their Shopify Payments settings in the Shopify Admin.

iana_timezone.name: iana_timezone
iana_timezone.description: The name of the timezone assigned by the [IANA](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601) when the shop was created.

count_orders.name: count_orders
count_orders.description: Count of the distinct orders placed on this day.

count_line_items.name: count_line_items
count_line_items.description: Count of the line items included in orders placed on this day.

count_customers.name: count_customers
count_customers.description: Count of distinct customers who placed an order on this day.

count_customer_emails.name: count_customer_emails
count_customer_emails.description: Count of distinct customer email addresses who placed an order on this day.

order_adjusted_total.name: order_adjusted_total
order_adjusted_total.description: Order total adjusted for refunds and other adjustments. The calculation used for this field is as follows: total price listed on the original order (including shipping costs and discounts) + adjustments + adjustments tax - total refunds - refunds tax The order_adjusted_total will equate to the total sales - refunds listed within the transactions table for the order (after currency exchange).

avg_order_value.name: avg_order_value
avg_order_value.description: Average adjusted total per order placed on this day (in shop currency).

shipping_cost.name: shipping_cost
shipping_cost.description: The shipping cost of the orders placed on this day (in shop currency).

order_adjustment_amount.name: order_adjustment_amount
order_adjustment_amount.description: Total adjustment amount (in shop currency) applied to the orders placed on this day.

order_adjustment_tax_amount.name: order_adjustment_tax_amount
order_adjustment_tax_amount.description: Total tax applied to adjustments (in shop currency) on the orders placed on this day.

refund_subtotal.name: refund_subtotal
refund_subtotal.description: Total refund amount applied to the orders placed on this day.

refund_total_tax.name: refund_total_tax
refund_total_tax.description: Total tax applied to the refund on the orders placed on this day (in shop currency).

total_discounts.name: total_discounts
total_discounts.description: The total amount of the discount allocated to this day's orders in the shop's currency.

shipping_discount_amount.name: shipping_discount_amount
shipping_discount_amount.description: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping for orders placed on this day.

percentage_calc_discount_amount.name: percentage_calc_discount_amount
percentage_calc_discount_amount.description: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated via a percentage-based discount for orders placed on this day.

fixed_amount_discount_amount.name: fixed_amount_discount_amount
fixed_amount_discount_amount.description: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated via a fixed-amount discount for orders placed on this day.

count_discount_codes_applied.name: count_discount_codes_applied
count_discount_codes_applied.description: Distinct discount codes applied by customers on orders for this day.

count_locations_ordered_from.name: count_locations_ordered_from
count_locations_ordered_from.description: Distinct locations with orders placed against them on this day.

count_orders_with_discounts.name: count_orders_with_discounts
count_orders_with_discounts.description: Count of orders in which a discount was applied.

count_orders_with_refunds.name: count_orders_with_refunds
count_orders_with_refunds.description: Count of orders in which there was a refund.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the first order of the day for the shop.

last_order_timestamp.name: last_order_timestamp
last_order_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last order of the day for the shop.

quantity_sold.name: quantity_sold
quantity_sold.description: Total quantity sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

quantity_refunded.name: quantity_refunded
quantity_refunded.description: The quantity of goods ORDERED on this day that have been refunded.

quantity_net.name: quantity_net
quantity_net.description: Net quantity sold from this shop on this day. Excludes refunds.

count_variants_sold.name: count_variants_sold
count_variants_sold.description: Distinct product variants sold on this day (includes refunds).

count_products_sold.name: count_products_sold
count_products_sold.description: Distinct products sold on this day (includes refunds).

quantity_gift_cards_sold.name: quantity_gift_cards_sold
quantity_gift_cards_sold.description: Quantity of gift cards sold on this day.

quantity_requiring_shipping.name: quantity_requiring_shipping
quantity_requiring_shipping.description: Quantity of goods sold on this day that require shipping.

count_abandoned_checkouts.name: count_abandoned_checkouts
count_abandoned_checkouts.description: Count of abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_customers_abandoned_checkout.name: count_customers_abandoned_checkout
count_customers_abandoned_checkout.description: Count of distinct customers who abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout.name: count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout
count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout.description: Count of distinct customer emails who abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_fulfillment_attempted_delivery.name: count_fulfillment_attempted_delivery
count_fulfillment_attempted_delivery.description: Count of distinct fulfillments on this day where the delivery of the shipment was attempted, but unable to be completed.

count_fulfillment_delivered.name: count_fulfillment_delivered
count_fulfillment_delivered.description: Count of successful distinct fulfillments successfully delivered on this day.

count_fulfillment_failure.name: count_fulfillment_failure
count_fulfillment_failure.description: Count of failed distinct fulfillments on this day. Something went wrong when pulling tracking information for the shipment, such as the tracking number was invalid or the shipment was canceled.

count_fulfillment_in_transit.name: count_fulfillment_in_transit
count_fulfillment_in_transit.description: Count of distinct fulfillments in transit on this day. Each shipment is being transported between shipping facilities on the way to its destination.

count_fulfillment_out_for_delivery.name: count_fulfillment_out_for_delivery
count_fulfillment_out_for_delivery.description: Count of distinct fulfillments being delivered to their final destination.

count_fulfillment_ready_for_pickup.name: count_fulfillment_ready_for_pickup
count_fulfillment_ready_for_pickup.description: Count of distinct fulfillments ready for pickup at a shipping depot.

count_fulfillment_label_printed.name: count_fulfillment_label_printed
count_fulfillment_label_printed.description: Count of distinct fulfillments for which a purchased shipping label has been printed on this day.

count_fulfillment_label_purchased.name: count_fulfillment_label_purchased
count_fulfillment_label_purchased.description: Count of distinct fulfillments for which a shipping label has been purchased (but not printed yet) on this day.

count_fulfillment_confirmed.name: count_fulfillment_confirmed
count_fulfillment_confirmed.description: Count of confirmed distinct fulfillments. This is the default status when no other information is available about a fulfillment.

avg_line_item_count.name: avg_line_item_count
avg_line_item_count.description: Average line item count for orders placed on this day.

avg_discount.name: avg_discount
avg_discount.description: Average total discount placed on orders on this day (in shop currency).

avg_shipping_discount_amount.name: avg_shipping_discount_amount
avg_shipping_discount_amount.description: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping on orders placed on this day.

avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount.name: avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount
avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount.description: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated via a percentage-based-discount on orders placed on this day.

avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount.name: avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount
avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount.description: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated via a fixed-amount-discount on orders placed on this day.

avg_quantity_sold.name: avg_quantity_sold
avg_quantity_sold.description: Average quantity sold per order on this day. Includes refunds. (in shop currency)

avg_quantity_net.name: avg_quantity_net
avg_quantity_net.description: Average net quantity sold per order on this day. Excludes refunds. (in shop currency)

gross_sales.name: gross_sales
gross_sales.description: The total revenue from sales before discounts and returns are applied for this day (in shop currency).

discounts.name: discounts
discounts.description: The total amount of discounts applied to orders on this day (in shop currency).

returns.name: returns
returns.description: The total value of goods returned on orders on this day (in shop currency).

net_sales.name: net_sales
net_sales.description: The net revenue from orders on this day after discounts and returns (gross_sales - discounts - returns, in shop currency).

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

        coalesce(order_aggregates.fixed_amount_discount_amount, 0) as fixed_amount_discount_amount,

            - coalesce(refund_discrepancy_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_amount, 0) as returns,

    left join refund_discrepancy_aggregates

__dbt__cte__int_shopify_gql__daily_orders as (


with orders as (

    select *
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."shopify_gql__orders"

    where not coalesce(is_deleted, false)
),

order_refunds as (

    select *
    from __dbt__cte__int_shopify_gql__orders_order_refunds

),

refunds as (

    select *
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."stg_shopify_gql__refund"

),

order_adjustments as (

    select *
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."stg_shopify_gql__order_adjustment"

),

order_lines as(

    select *
    from "postgres"."public_shopify_dev"."shopify_gql__order_lines"
),

order_aggregates as (

    select
        source_relation,
        cast(date_trunc('day', created_timestamp) as date) as date_day,
        count(distinct order_id) as count_orders,
        sum(coalesce(line_item_count, 0)) as count_line_items,
        avg(line_item_count) as avg_line_item_count,
        count(distinct customer_id) as count_customers,
        count(distinct email) as count_customer_emails,
        sum(coalesce(order_adjusted_total, 0)) as order_adjusted_total,
        avg(order_adjusted_total) as avg_order_value,
        sum(coalesce(shipping_cost_shop_amount, 0)) as shipping_cost,
        sum(coalesce(order_adjustment_amount, 0)) as order_adjustment_amount,
        sum(coalesce(order_adjustment_tax_amount, 0)) as order_adjustment_tax_amount,
        sum(coalesce(total_discounts_shop_amount, 0)) as total_discounts,
        avg(total_discounts_shop_amount) as avg_discount,
        sum(coalesce(shipping_discount_amount, 0)) as shipping_discount_amount,
        avg(shipping_discount_amount) as avg_shipping_discount_amount,
        sum(coalesce(percentage_calc_discount_amount, 0)) as percentage_calc_discount_amount,
        avg(percentage_calc_discount_amount) as avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount,
        sum(coalesce(fixed_amount_discount_amount, 0)) as fixed_amount_discount_amount,
        avg(fixed_amount_discount_amount) as avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount,
        sum(coalesce(count_discount_codes_applied, 0)) as count_discount_codes_applied,
        count(distinct location_id) as count_locations_ordered_from,
        sum(coalesce(case when count_discount_codes_applied > 0 then 1 else 0 end, 0)) as count_orders_with_discounts,
        min(created_timestamp) as first_order_timestamp,
        max(created_timestamp) as last_order_timestamp,
        sum(gross_sales) as gross_sales,
        sum(discounts) as discounts

    from orders
    group by 1,2

),

refund_aggregates as (

    select
        source_relation,
        cast(date_trunc('day', created_at) as date) as date_day,
        sum(subtotal) as refund_subtotal,
        sum(total_tax) as refund_total_tax,
        count(distinct order_id) as count_orders_with_refunds,
        sum(case when not is_gift_card then coalesce(subtotal, 0) else 0 end) as refund_subtotal_non_gift_card
    from order_refunds
    group by 1, 2

),

refund_discrepancy_aggregates as (

    select
        refunds.source_relation,
        cast(date_trunc('day', refunds.created_at) as date) as date_day,
        sum(amount_shop) as refund_discrepancy_amount
    from refunds
    inner join order_adjustments
        on refunds.refund_id = order_adjustments.refund_id
        and refunds.source_relation = order_adjustments.source_relation
    where lower(order_adjustments.reason) = 'refund_discrepancy'
    group by 1, 2

),

order_line_aggregates as (

    select
        order_lines.source_relation,
        cast(date_trunc('day', orders.created_timestamp) as date) as date_day,
        sum(coalesce(order_lines.quantity, 0)) as quantity_sold,
        sum(coalesce(order_lines.refunded_quantity, 0)) as quantity_refunded,
        sum(coalesce(order_lines.quantity_net_refunds, 0)) as quantity_net,
        sum(coalesce(order_lines.quantity, 0)) / count(distinct order_lines.order_id) as avg_quantity_sold,
        sum(coalesce(order_lines.quantity_net_refunds, 0)) / count(distinct order_lines.order_id) as avg_quantity_net,
        count(distinct order_lines.variant_id) as count_variants_sold,
        count(distinct order_lines.product_id) as count_products_sold,
        sum(coalesce(case when order_lines.is_gift_card then order_lines.quantity_net_refunds else 0 end, 0)) as quantity_gift_cards_sold,
        sum(coalesce(case when order_lines.is_shipping_required then order_lines.quantity_net_refunds else 0 end, 0)) as quantity_requiring_shipping

    from order_lines
    left join orders -- just joining with order to get the created_timestamp
        on order_lines.order_id = orders.order_id
        and order_lines.source_relation = orders.source_relation

    group by 1,2
),

final as (

    select
        coalesce(order_aggregates.source_relation, refund_aggregates.source_relation) as source_relation,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.date_day, refund_aggregates.date_day) as date_day,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_orders, 0) as count_orders,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_line_items, 0) as count_line_items,
        order_aggregates.avg_line_item_count,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_customers, 0) as count_customers,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_customer_emails, 0) as count_customer_emails,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.order_adjusted_total, 0) as order_adjusted_total,
        order_aggregates.avg_order_value,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.shipping_cost, 0) as shipping_cost,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.order_adjustment_amount, 0) as order_adjustment_amount,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.order_adjustment_tax_amount, 0) as order_adjustment_tax_amount,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.total_discounts, 0) as total_discounts,
        order_aggregates.avg_discount,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.shipping_discount_amount, 0) as shipping_discount_amount,
        order_aggregates.avg_shipping_discount_amount,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.percentage_calc_discount_amount, 0) as percentage_calc_discount_amount,
        order_aggregates.avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.fixed_amount_discount_amount, 0) as fixed_amount_discount_amount,
        order_aggregates.avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_discount_codes_applied, 0) as count_discount_codes_applied,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_locations_ordered_from, 0) as count_locations_ordered_from,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.count_orders_with_discounts, 0) as count_orders_with_discounts,
        order_aggregates.first_order_timestamp,
        order_aggregates.last_order_timestamp,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.gross_sales, 0) as gross_sales,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.discounts, 0) as discounts,
        coalesce(refund_aggregates.refund_subtotal, 0) as refund_subtotal,
        coalesce(refund_aggregates.refund_total_tax, 0) as refund_total_tax,
        coalesce(refund_aggregates.count_orders_with_refunds, 0) as count_orders_with_refunds,
        coalesce(refund_aggregates.refund_subtotal_non_gift_card, 0)
            - coalesce(refund_discrepancy_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_amount, 0) as returns,
        coalesce(order_aggregates.gross_sales, 0)
            - coalesce(order_aggregates.discounts, 0)
            - (coalesce(refund_aggregates.refund_subtotal_non_gift_card, 0)
                - coalesce(refund_discrepancy_aggregates.refund_discrepancy_amount, 0)) as net_sales,
        order_line_aggregates.quantity_sold,
        order_line_aggregates.quantity_refunded,
        order_line_aggregates.quantity_net,
        order_line_aggregates.count_variants_sold,
        order_line_aggregates.count_products_sold,
        order_line_aggregates.quantity_gift_cards_sold,
        order_line_aggregates.quantity_requiring_shipping,
        order_line_aggregates.avg_quantity_sold,
        order_line_aggregates.avg_quantity_net

    from order_aggregates
    full outer join refund_aggregates
        on order_aggregates.date_day = refund_aggregates.date_day
        and order_aggregates.source_relation = refund_aggregates.source_relation
    left join refund_discrepancy_aggregates
        on coalesce(order_aggregates.date_day, refund_aggregates.date_day) = refund_discrepancy_aggregates.date_day
        and coalesce(order_aggregates.source_relation, refund_aggregates.source_relation) = refund_discrepancy_aggregates.source_relation
    left join order_line_aggregates
        on coalesce(order_aggregates.date_day, refund_aggregates.date_day) = order_line_aggregates.date_day
        and coalesce(order_aggregates.source_relation, refund_aggregates.source_relation) = order_line_aggregates.source_relation
)

from final
)

{{
    config(
        enabled=var('shopify_api', 'rest') == var('shopify_api_override','graphql'),
        materialized='table' if shopify.shopify_is_databricks_sql_warehouse() else 'incremental',
        unique_key='customer_cohort_id',
        incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite' if target.type in ('bigquery', 'databricks', 'spark') else 'delete+insert',
        partition_by={
            "field": "date_month", 
            "data_type": "date"
            } if target.type not in ('spark', 'databricks', 'duckdb') 
            else ['date_month'],
        cluster_by=['date_month', 'email'],
        file_format='delta' if shopify.shopify_is_databricks_sql_warehouse() else 'parquet'
        ) 
}}

with calendar as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('shopify__calendar') }}
    where cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('month','date_day') }} as date) = date_day

    {% if is_incremental() %}
    and cast(date_day as date) >= {{ shopify.shopify_lookback(from_date="max(date_month)", interval=1, datepart='month') }}
    {% endif %}

), customers as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('shopify_gql__customer_emails') }}

), orders as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('shopify_gql__orders') }}

), customer_calendar as (

    select
        cast(calendar.date_day as date) as date_month,
        customers.email,
        customers.first_order_timestamp,
        customers.source_relation,
        {{ dbt.date_trunc('month', 'first_order_timestamp') }} as cohort_month
    from calendar
    inner join customers
        on cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('month', 'first_order_timestamp') }} as date) <= calendar.date_day

), orders_joined as (

    select 
        customer_calendar.date_month, 
        customer_calendar.email, 
        customer_calendar.first_order_timestamp,
        customer_calendar.cohort_month,
        customer_calendar.source_relation,
        coalesce(count(distinct orders.order_id), 0) as order_count_in_month,
        coalesce(sum(orders.order_adjusted_total), 0) as total_price_in_month,
        coalesce(sum(orders.line_item_count), 0) as line_item_count_in_month
    from customer_calendar
    left join orders
        on customer_calendar.email = orders.email
        and customer_calendar.source_relation = orders.source_relation
        and customer_calendar.date_month = cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('month', 'created_timestamp') }} as date)
    {{ dbt_utils.group_by(n=5) }}

), windows as (

    {% set partition_string = 'partition by email ' ~ fivetran_utils.partition_by_source_relation(package_name='shopify') ~ 'order by date_month rows between unbounded preceding and current row' %}

    select

model.shopify.shopify_gql__discounts.description: Each record represents a unique discount, enriched with discount metadata and metrics regarding orders and abandoned checkouts.

unique_key.name: unique_key
unique_key.description:
Unique key representing a discount.
Hashed on 'source_relation', 'discount_code_id', 'discount_id', 'discount_type',
'code', 'allocation_method', 'target_selection', 'target_type', 'value_amount',
'value_currency_code', 'value_percentage', 'value_type'.

code.name: code
code.description: The case-insensitive discount code that customers use at checkout.

discount_code_id.name: discount_code_id
discount_code_id.description: The ID for the discount code.

applies_once_per_customer.name: applies_once_per_customer
applies_once_per_customer.description: Whether the discount can be used only once per customer.

usage_count.name: usage_count
usage_count.description: Number of times the discount has been used (asynchronously updated).

codes_count.name: codes_count
codes_count.description: Number of unique redeem codes associated with the discount.

codes_precision.name: codes_precision
codes_precision.description: Indicates whether `codes_count` is exact or estimated.

combines_with_order_discounts.name: combines_with_order_discounts
combines_with_order_discounts.description: Whether this discount can be combined with order-level discounts.

combines_with_product_discounts.name: combines_with_product_discounts
combines_with_product_discounts.description: Whether this discount can be combined with product-level discounts.

combines_with_shipping_discounts.name: combines_with_shipping_discounts
combines_with_shipping_discounts.description: Whether this discount can be combined with shipping-level discounts.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Timestamp when the discount was created.

customer_selection_all_customers.name: customer_selection_all_customers
customer_selection_all_customers.description: Whether the discount is available to all customers.

ends_at.name: ends_at
ends_at.description: Timestamp when the discount ends or expires.

starts_at.name: starts_at
starts_at.description: Timestamp when the discount becomes active.

status.name: status
status.description: Current status of the discount (e.g. 'active', 'expired', 'scheduled').

title.name: title
title.description: The discount’s display name in the Shopify admin and to customers.

total_sales_amount.name: total_sales_amount
total_sales_amount.description: The total sales amount that resulted from the usage of this discount.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.description: Timestamp when the discount was last updated.

usage_limit.name: usage_limit
usage_limit.description: The total number of times the discount code can be used.

allocation_method.name: allocation_method
allocation_method.description: The method by which the discount is allocated. Valid values include `each` (applies the discount to each eligible item) and `across` (spreads the discount value across eligible items).

target_selection.name: target_selection
target_selection.description: Indicates whether the discount applies to 'all' or 'entitled' items.

target_type.name: target_type
target_type.description: The type of target this discount applies to (e.g., `line_item` or `shipping_line`).

value_amount.name: value_amount
value_amount.description: The numerical value of the discount application. A monetary value in decimal format, allowing for precise representation of cents or fractional currency.

value_type.name: value_type
value_type.description: How the discount value is interpreted (e.g., 'percentage', 'fixed_amount').

value_currency_code.name: value_currency_code
value_currency_code.description: The three-letter currency code for the discount that represents a world currency used in a store.

value_percentage.name: value_percentage
value_percentage.description: The percentage discount value that is applied to a line, a number ranging between -100 (free) and 0 (no discount)

total_order_discount_amount.name: total_order_discount_amount
total_order_discount_amount.description: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of discounts taken off of orders.

total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount.name: total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount
total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount.description: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of discounts taken off abandoned checkout orders.

total_order_line_items_price.name: total_order_line_items_price

total_order_shipping_cost.name: total_order_shipping_cost
total_order_shipping_cost.description: Total shipping costs for orders that used this discount.

total_order_refund_amount.name: total_order_refund_amount

model.shopify.shopify_gql__refund_lines.name: shopify_gql__refund_lines
model.shopify.shopify_gql__refund_lines.description: Each record represents a refunded order line item. Joins refund, order line refund, order line, and order context for line-item level refund analysis. When the `shopify_gql_using_return` variable is enabled, additional return lifecycle columns are included.

unique_key.name: unique_key
unique_key.description: Unique key representing a refunded order line item. Hashed on 'order_line_refund_id' and 'source_relation'.

refund_id.name: refund_id
refund_id.description: The ID of the refund.

return_id.name: return_id
return_id.description: The ID of the return associated with this refund, if applicable.

order_line_refund_id.name: order_line_refund_id
order_line_refund_id.description: The ID of the refunded order line item.

order_line_id.name: order_line_id
order_line_id.description: The ID of the associated order line item.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: The ID of the order the refund belongs to.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.description: The ID of the customer who placed the original order.

email.name: email
email.description: The email address of the customer who placed the original order.

order_channel.name: order_channel
order_channel.description: The channel where the original order was placed (e.g. web, pos).

order_created_at.name: order_created_at
order_created_at.description: The timestamp when the original order was created.

refund_created_at.name: refund_created_at
refund_created_at.description: The timestamp when the refund was created.

refund_updated_at.name: refund_updated_at
refund_updated_at.description: The timestamp when the refund was last updated.

days_to_refund.name: days_to_refund
days_to_refund.description: Number of days between the original order creation date and the refund creation date.

refund_note.name: refund_note
refund_note.description: An optional note attached to the refund by the merchant or staff.

staff_user_id.name: staff_user_id
staff_user_id.description: The ID of the staff member who processed the refund.

has_return.name: has_return
has_return.description: Whether this refund was initiated via a return request. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_name.name: return_name
return_name.description: The name of the return associated with this refund. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_status.name: return_status
return_status.description: The status of the return (e.g. OPEN, CLOSED). Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_decline_reason.name: return_decline_reason
return_decline_reason.description: The reason the return was declined, if applicable. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_decline_note.name: return_decline_note
return_decline_note.description: A note explaining why the return was declined. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_reason_note.name: return_reason_note
return_reason_note.description: An optional note providing more detail on the return reason. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_customer_note.name: return_customer_note
return_customer_note.description: A note from the customer about why they are returning this item. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

return_requested_quantity.name: return_requested_quantity
return_requested_quantity.description: The quantity of this line item the customer requested to return. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

refundable_quantity.name: refundable_quantity
refundable_quantity.description: The quantity of this line item that is eligible for a refund. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

refunded_quantity.name: refunded_quantity
refunded_quantity.description: The quantity of this line item that has been refunded. Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

pending_refund_quantity.name: pending_refund_quantity
pending_refund_quantity.description: The quantity that has been physically returned but not yet financially processed (refundable_quantity - refunded_quantity). Only populated when `shopify_gql_using_return` is enabled.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.description: The ID of the product associated with the refunded line item.

variant_id.name: variant_id
variant_id.description: The ID of the product variant associated with the refunded line item.

product_title.name: product_title
product_title.description: The title of the product at the time of the original order.

sku.name: sku
sku.description: The SKU of the product variant at the time of the original order.

vendor.name: vendor
vendor.description: The vendor of the product at the time of the original order.

original_total_price_shop_amount.name: original_total_price_shop_amount
original_total_price_shop_amount.description: The total price of the product variant at the time of the original order in shop currency.

original_total_price_pres_amount.name: original_total_price_pres_amount
original_total_price_pres_amount.description: The total price of the product variant at the time of the original order in presentment currency.

original_total_price_pres_currency_code.name: original_total_price_pres_currency_code
original_total_price_pres_currency_code.description: The presentment currency code for the original total price.

is_gift_card.name: is_gift_card
is_gift_card.description: Whether the refunded line item was a gift card.

refund_line_item_quantity.name: refund_line_item_quantity
refund_line_item_quantity.description: The quantity of items refunded on this line item.

price_shop_amount.name: price_shop_amount
price_shop_amount.description: The per-unit price of the refunded item in shop currency.

subtotal_shop_amount.name: subtotal_shop_amount
subtotal_shop_amount.description: The subtotal of the refund for this line item, before tax, in shop currency.

total_tax_shop_amount.name: total_tax_shop_amount
total_tax_shop_amount.description: The total tax refunded for this line item in shop currency.

total_refunded_line_shop_amount.name: total_refunded_line_shop_amount
total_refunded_line_shop_amount.description: The total amount refunded for this line item including tax in shop currency. Equal to subtotal_shop_amount + total_tax_shop_amount.

price_pres_amount.name: price_pres_amount
price_pres_amount.description: The per-unit price of the refunded item in presentment currency.

price_pres_currency_code.name: price_pres_currency_code
price_pres_currency_code.description: The presentment currency code for the per-unit refund price.

subtotal_pres_amount.name: subtotal_pres_amount
subtotal_pres_amount.description: The subtotal of the refund for this line item, before tax, in presentment currency.

subtotal_pres_currency_code.name: subtotal_pres_currency_code
subtotal_pres_currency_code.description: The presentment currency code for the refund subtotal.

total_tax_pres_amount.name: total_tax_pres_amount
total_tax_pres_amount.description: The total tax refunded for this line item in presentment currency.

total_tax_pres_currency_code.name: total_tax_pres_currency_code
total_tax_pres_currency_code.description: The presentment currency code for the refund tax amount.

total_refunded_line_pres_amount.name: total_refunded_line_pres_amount
total_refunded_line_pres_amount.description: The total amount refunded for this line item including tax in presentment currency. Equal to subtotal_pres_amount + total_tax_pres_amount.

restock_type.name: restock_type
restock_type.description: How the refunded item was restocked. One of 'return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock', or 'no_restock'.

restock_location_id.name: restock_location_id
restock_location_id.description: The ID of the location where the item was restocked, if applicable.

is_restocked.name: is_restocked
is_restocked.description: Whether the item was physically restocked (restock_type is 'return', 'cancel', or 'legacy_restock').

is_restock_only.name: is_restock_only
is_restock_only.description: Whether this refund line had no financial value and only restocked inventory (subtotal_shop_amount and total_tax_shop_amount are both zero and the item was restocked).

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

model.shopify.shopify_gql__refund_lines.raw_code:
{{ config(enabled=var('shopify_api', 'rest') == var('shopify_api_override','graphql')) }}

with refunds as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__refund') }}

), order_line_refunds as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order_line_refund') }}

), order_lines as (

    select
        order_line_id,
        order_id,
        source_relation,
        product_id,
        variant_id,
        title,
        sku,
        vendor,
        is_gift_card,
        price_shop_amount as original_total_price_shop_amount,
        price_pres_amount as original_total_price_pres_amount,
        price_pres_currency_code as original_total_price_pres_currency_code
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order_line') }}

), orders as (

    select
        order_id,
        source_relation,
        customer_id,
        email,
        source_name,
        created_timestamp as order_created_at
    from {{ ref('int_shopify_gql__order') }}

{% if var('shopify_gql_using_return', False) %}
), returns as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__return') }}

), return_line_items as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__return_line_item') }}

{% endif %}

), joined as (

    select
        -- identity / keys
        order_line_refunds.unique_key,
        refunds.refund_id,
        refunds.source_relation,
        refunds.return_id,
        order_line_refunds.order_line_refund_id,
        order_line_refunds.order_line_id,
        refunds.order_id,

        -- order context
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.email,
        orders.source_name as order_channel,
        orders.order_created_at,

        -- timing
        refunds.created_at as refund_created_at,
        refunds.updated_at as refund_updated_at,
        {{ dbt.datediff('cast(orders.order_created_at as date)', 'cast(refunds.created_at as date)', 'day') }} as days_to_refund,

        -- refund metadata
        refunds.note as refund_note,
        refunds.user_id as staff_user_id,

        {% if var('shopify_gql_using_return', False) %}
        -- return lifecycle (null when refund was not initiated via a return request)
        returns.return_id is not null as has_return,
        returns.name as return_name,
        returns.status as return_status,
        returns.decline_reason as return_decline_reason,
        returns.decline_note as return_decline_note,

        -- return line item detail (why the customer returned this specific item)
        return_line_items.return_reason_note,
        return_line_items.customer_note as return_customer_note,
        return_line_items.quantity as return_requested_quantity,
        return_line_items.refundable_quantity,
        return_line_items.refunded_quantity,
        -- items physically returned but not yet financially processed
        (coalesce(return_line_items.refundable_quantity, 0) - coalesce(return_line_items.refunded_quantity, 0)) as pending_refund_quantity,
        {% endif %}

        -- product context (values at time of original order)
        order_lines.product_id,
        order_lines.variant_id,
        order_lines.title as product_title,
        order_lines.sku,
        order_lines.vendor,
        order_lines.original_total_price_shop_amount,
        order_lines.original_total_price_pres_amount,
        order_lines.original_total_price_pres_currency_code,
        order_lines.is_gift_card,

        -- refund line financials (shop currency)
        order_line_refunds.quantity as refund_line_item_quantity,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.price_shop_amount, 0) as price_shop_amount,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_shop_amount, 0) as subtotal_shop_amount,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_shop_amount, 0) as total_tax_shop_amount,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_shop_amount, 0) + coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_shop_amount, 0) as total_refunded_line_shop_amount,

        -- refund line financials (presentment currency)
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.price_pres_amount, 0) as price_pres_amount,
        order_line_refunds.price_pres_currency_code,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_pres_amount, 0) as subtotal_pres_amount,
        order_line_refunds.subtotal_pres_currency_code,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_pres_amount, 0) as total_tax_pres_amount,
        order_line_refunds.total_tax_pres_currency_code,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_pres_amount, 0) + coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_pres_amount, 0) as total_refunded_line_pres_amount,

        -- inventory / restock classification
        order_line_refunds.restock_type,
        order_line_refunds.location_id as restock_location_id,
        order_line_refunds.restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock') as is_restocked,
        (coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_shop_amount, 0) = 0
            and coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_shop_amount, 0) = 0
            and order_line_refunds.restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock')) as is_restock_only

    from order_line_refunds
    join refunds
        on order_line_refunds.refund_id = refunds.refund_id
        and order_line_refunds.source_relation = refunds.source_relation
    left join order_lines
        on order_line_refunds.order_line_id = order_lines.order_line_id
        and order_line_refunds.source_relation = order_lines.source_relation
    left join orders
        on refunds.order_id = orders.order_id
        and refunds.source_relation = orders.source_relation
    {% if var('shopify_gql_using_return', False) %}
    left join returns
        on refunds.return_id = returns.return_id
        and refunds.source_relation = returns.source_relation
    left join return_line_items
        on refunds.return_id = return_line_items.return_id
        and order_line_refunds.order_line_id = return_line_items.order_line_id
        and order_line_refunds.source_relation = return_line_items.source_relation
    {% endif %}

)

from joined

        coalesce(order_line_refunds.price_pres_amount, 0) as price_pres_amount,
        order_line_refunds.price_pres_currency_code,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_pres_amount, 0) as subtotal_pres_amount,
        order_line_refunds.subtotal_pres_currency_code,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_pres_amount, 0) as total_tax_pres_amount,
        order_line_refunds.total_tax_pres_currency_code,
        coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_pres_amount, 0) + coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_pres_amount, 0) as total_refunded_line_pres_amount,

        -- inventory / restock classification
        order_line_refunds.restock_type,
        order_line_refunds.location_id as restock_location_id,
        order_line_refunds.restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock') as is_restocked,
        (coalesce(order_line_refunds.subtotal_shop_amount, 0) = 0
            and coalesce(order_line_refunds.total_tax_shop_amount, 0) = 0
            and order_line_refunds.restock_type in ('return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock')) as is_restock_only

    from order_line_refunds
    join refunds
        on order_line_refunds.refund_id = refunds.refund_id
        and order_line_refunds.source_relation = refunds.source_relation
    left join order_lines
        on order_line_refunds.order_line_id = order_lines.order_line_id
        and order_line_refunds.source_relation = order_lines.source_relation
    left join orders
        on refunds.order_id = orders.order_id
        and refunds.source_relation = orders.source_relation
    
    left join returns
        on refunds.return_id = returns.return_id
        and refunds.source_relation = returns.source_relation
    left join return_line_items
        on refunds.return_id = return_line_items.return_id
        and order_line_refunds.order_line_id = return_line_items.order_line_id
        and order_line_refunds.source_relation = return_line_items.source_relation
    

)

model.shopify.stg_shopify_gql__fulfillme.description: The FulfillmentEvent resource represents tracking events that belong to a fulfillment of one or more items in an order.  Fulfillment events are displayed on the order status page to update customers on the status of their shipment.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.description: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

address_1.description: The street address where the fulfillment event occurred.

city.name: city
city.description: The city where the fulfillment event occurred.

country.name: country
country.description: The country where the fulfillment event occurred.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment event was created.

estimated_delivery_at.name: estimated_delivery_at
estimated_delivery_at.description: The estimated delivery date based on the fulfillment's tracking number, as long as it's provided by one of the following carriers: USPS, FedEx, UPS, or Canada Post (Canada only).  Value is `null` if no tracking number is available or if the tracking number is from an unsupported carrier. This property is available only when carrier calculated rates are in use.

fulfillment_id.name: fulfillment_id
fulfillment_id.description: An ID for the fulfillment that's associated with the fulfillment event.

happened_at.name: happened_at
happened_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment event occurred.

fulfillment_event_id.name: fulfillment_event_id
fulfillment_event_id.description: An ID for the fulfillment event.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.description: A geographic coordinate specifying the latitude of the fulfillment event.

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.description: A geographic coordinate specifying the longitude of the fulfillment event.

message.name: message
message.description: An arbitrary message describing the status. Can be provided by a shipping carrier.

province.name: province
province.description: The province where the fulfillment event occurred.

status.name: status
status.description: The status of the fulfillment event. Valid values: - label_printed: A label for the shipment was purchased and printed. - label_purchased: A label for the shipment was purchased, but not printed. - attempted_delivery: Delivery of the shipment was attempted, but unable to be completed. - ready_for_pickup: The shipment is ready for pickup at a shipping depot. - picked_up: The fulfillment was successfully picked up. - confirmed: The carrier is aware of the shipment, but hasn't received it yet. - in_transit: The shipment is being transported between shipping facilities on the way to its destination. - out_for_delivery: The shipment is being delivered to its final destination. - delivered: The shipment was successfully delivered. - failure: Something went wrong when pulling tracking information for the shipment, such as the tracking number was invalid or the shipment was canceled.

zip.name: zip
zip.description: The zip code of the location where the fulfillment event occurred.

source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

model.shopify.stg_shopify_gql__inventory.description: An inventory item represents a physical good. It holds essential information about the physical good, including its SKU and whether its inventory is tracked. There is a 1:1 relationship between a product variant and an inventory item.

inventory_item_id.name: inventory_item_id
inventory_item_id.description: The ID of the inventory item.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.description: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.description: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

country_code_of_origin.name: country_code_of_origin
country_code_of_origin.description: The country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of where the item came from.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was created.

province_code_of_origin.name: province_code_of_origin
province_code_of_origin.description: The province code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2) of where the item came from. The province code is only used if the shipping provider for the inventory item is Canada Post.

is_shipping_required.name: is_shipping_required
is_shipping_required.description: Boolean representing whether a customer needs to provide a shipping address when placing an order containing the inventory item.

sku.name: sku
sku.description: The unique SKU (stock keeping unit) of the inventory item.

is_inventory_quantity_tracked.name: is_inventory_quantity_tracked
is_inventory_quantity_tracked.description: Boolean representing whether inventory levels are tracked for the item. If true, then the inventory quantity changes are tracked by Shopify.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was last modified.

duplicate_sku_count.name: duplicate_sku_count
duplicate_sku_count.description: The number of inventory items that share the same SKU with this item.

harmonized_system_code.name: harmonized_system_code
harmonized_system_code.description: The harmonized system code of the item.

inventory_history_url.name: inventory_history_url
inventory_history_url.description: The URL that points to the inventory history for the item.

legacy_resource_id.name: legacy_resource_id
legacy_resource_id.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

measurement_id.name: measurement_id
measurement_id.description: The unique identifier for the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_value.name: measurement_weight_value
measurement_weight_value.description: The weight value of the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_unit.name: measurement_weight_unit
measurement_weight_unit.description: The unit of measurement for the inventory item's weight.

tracked_editable_reason.name: tracked_editable_reason
tracked_editable_reason.description: Provides the reason why the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

unit_cost_amount.name: unit_cost_amount
unit_cost_amount.description: Decimal money amount of the unit cost associated with the inventory item.

unit_cost_currency_code.name: unit_cost_currency_code
unit_cost_currency_code.description: Currency of the unit cost associated with the inventory item.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

is_tracked_editable_locked.name: is_tracked_editable_locked
is_tracked_editable_locked.description: Indicates whether the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

model.shopify.stg_shopify_gql__metafield.description: Metafields are a flexible way to attach additional information to a Shopify resource (e.g. Product, Collection, etc.). Some examples of data stored using metafields include specifications, size charts,  downloadable documents, release dates, images, or part numbers. Metafields are identified by an owner resource, a namespace, and a key and they store a value along with type information for that context.

metafield_id.name: metafield_id
metafield_id.description: The unique ID of the metafield.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.description: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was created.

description.name: description
description.description: A description of the information that the metafield contains.

key.name: key
key.description: The key of the metafield. Keys can be up to 64 characters long and can contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, underscores, and periods.

namespace.name: namespace
namespace.description: A container for a group of metafields. Grouping metafields within a namespace prevents your metafields from conflicting with other metafields with the same key name. Must have between 3-255 characters.

owner_resource_id.name: owner_resource_id
owner_resource_id.description: The unique ID of the resource that the metafield is attached to.

owner_resource.name: owner_resource
owner_resource.description: The type of resource (table) that the metafield is attached to.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was last updated.

value.name: value
value.description: The data to store in the metafield. The value is always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.

metafield_reference.name: metafield_reference
metafield_reference.description: Combination of the namespace and key columns. This field is key for metafield mapping in downstream models.

is_most_recent_record.name: is_most_recent_record
is_most_recent_record.description: Boolean indicating the most up to date record identified by the most recent updated_at field.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

model.shopify.stg_shopify_gql__fulfillme.name: stg_shopify_gql__fulfillment
model.shopify.stg_shopify_gql__fulfillme.description: A fulfillment order represents a group of one or more items in an order that will be fulfilled from the same location.  A fulfillment represents work that is completed as part of a fulfillment order and can include one or more items.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.description: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: The date and time when the fulfillment was created. The API returns this value in ISO 8601 format.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.description: The unique identifier of the location that the fulfillment was processed at.

name.name: name
name.description: The uniquely identifying fulfillment name, consisting of two parts separated by a .. The first part represents the order name and the second part represents the fulfillment number.  The fulfillment number automatically increments depending on how many fulfillments are in an order (e.g. #1001.1, #1001.2).

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: The unique numeric identifier for the order.

service.name: service
service.description: The fulfillment service associated with the fulfillment.

shipment_status.name: shipment_status
shipment_status.description: The current shipment status of the fulfillment. Valid values include: - label_printed: A label for the shipment was purchased and printed. - label_purchased: A label for the shipment was purchased, but not printed. - attempted_delivery: Delivery of the shipment was attempted, but unable to be completed. - ready_for_pickup: The shipment is ready for pickup at a shipping depot. - confirmed: The carrier is aware of the shipment, but hasn't received it yet. - in_transit: The shipment is being transported between shipping facilities on the way to its destination. - out_for_delivery: The shipment is being delivered to its final destination. - delivered: The shipment was successfully delivered. - failure: Something went wrong when pulling tracking information for the shipment, such as the tracking number was invalid or the shipment was canceled.

status.name: status
status.description: The status of the fulfillment. Valid values include: - pending: Shopify has created the fulfillment and is waiting for the third-party fulfillment service to transition it to 'open' or 'success'. - open: The fulfillment has been acknowledged by the service and is in processing. - success: The fulfillment was successful. - cancelled: The fulfillment was cancelled. - error: There was an error with the fulfillment request. - failure: The fulfillment request failed.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment was last modified.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.description: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

{{ config(
    materialized='table', 
    enabled=var('shopify_api', 'rest') == var('shopify_api_override','graphql')

with order_line as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order_line') }}

), orders as (

    select
        order_id,
        source_relation,
        financial_status
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order') }}

), discount_allocations as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__discount_allocation') }}

), tax as (

    select
        *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__tax_line') }}

), shipping as (

    select
        *
    from {{ ref('int_shopify_gql__order_shipping_aggregates')}}

), tax_aggregates as (

    select
        order_line_id,
        source_relation,
        sum(coalesce(price_shop_amount, 0)) as price

    from tax
    group by 1,2

), discount_allocation_agg as (

    select
        order_line_id,
        source_relation,
        sum(coalesce(allocated_shop_amount, 0)) as discount_allocation_amount

    from discount_allocations
    group by 1,2

with order_lines as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('int_shopify_gql__order_line') }}
),

fulfillment as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__fulfillment') }}
),

orders as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order') }}
    where not coalesce(is_deleted, false)
), 

refunds as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('int_shopify_gql__orders_order_refunds') }}

    select

        source_relation,
        sum(quantity) as quantity,

    from refunds
    group by 1,2
),

joined as (

    select
        order_lines.order_line_id,
        order_lines.variant_id,
        order_lines.source_relation,
        fulfillment.location_id, -- location id is stored in fulfillment rather than order

        order_lines.pre_tax_price,
        order_lines.quantity,
        orders.created_timestamp as order_created_timestamp,
        fulfillment.status as fulfillment_status, 
        refunds_aggregated.subtotal as subtotal_sold_refunds,

    from order_lines
    join orders
        on order_lines.order_id = orders.order_id
        and order_lines.source_relation = orders.source_relation
    join fulfillment
        on orders.order_id = fulfillment.order_id
        and orders.source_relation = fulfillment.source_relation
    left join refunds_aggregated
        on refunds_aggregated.order_line_id = order_lines.order_line_id
        and refunds_aggregated.source_relation = order_lines.source_relation
),

    select

        {% endfor %}

        , sum(coalesce(subtotal_sold_refunds, 0)) as subtotal_sold_refunds
        , sum(coalesce(quantity_sold_refunds, 0)) as quantity_sold_refunds

    from joined

    {{ dbt_utils.group_by(n=3) }}
)

{{ config(enabled=var('shopify_api', 'rest') == var('shopify_api_override','graphql')) }}

with orders as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_shopify_gql__order') }}
    where customer_id is not null

), order_aggregates as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('int_shopify_gql__orders_order_line_aggregates') }}

), transactions as (

    select *
    from {{ ref('shopify_gql__transactions')}}

    where lower(status) = 'success'
    and lower(kind) not in ('authorization', 'void')
    and lower(gateway) != 'gift_card' -- redeeming a giftcard does not introduce new revenue

), transaction_aggregates as (
    -- this is necessary as customers can pay via multiple payment gateways
    select 
        order_id,
        source_relation,
        lower(kind) as kind,
        sum(currency_exchange_calculated_amount) as currency_exchange_calculated_amount

    from transactions
    group by 1, 2, 3

), aggregated as (

    select
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.source_relation,
        min(orders.created_timestamp) as first_order_timestamp,
        max(orders.created_timestamp) as most_recent_order_timestamp,
        avg(transaction_aggregates.currency_exchange_calculated_amount) as avg_order_value,
        sum(transaction_aggregates.currency_exchange_calculated_amount) as lifetime_total_spent,
        sum(refunds.currency_exchange_calculated_amount) as lifetime_total_refunded,
        count(distinct orders.order_id) as lifetime_count_orders,
        avg(order_aggregates.order_total_quantity) as avg_quantity_per_order,
        sum(order_aggregates.order_total_tax) as lifetime_total_tax,
        avg(order_aggregates.order_total_tax) as avg_tax_per_order,
        sum(order_aggregates.discount_allocation_amount) as lifetime_total_discount,
        avg(order_aggregates.discount_allocation_amount) as avg_discount_per_order,
        sum(order_aggregates.order_total_shipping) as lifetime_total_shipping,
        avg(order_aggregates.order_total_shipping) as avg_shipping_per_order,
        sum(order_aggregates.order_total_shipping_with_discounts) as lifetime_total_shipping_with_discounts,
        avg(order_aggregates.order_total_shipping_with_discounts) as avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order,
        sum(order_aggregates.order_total_shipping_tax) as lifetime_total_shipping_tax,
        avg(order_aggregates.order_total_shipping_tax) as avg_shipping_tax_per_order

    from orders
    left join transaction_aggregates 
        on orders.order_id = transaction_aggregates.order_id
        and orders.source_relation = transaction_aggregates.source_relation
        and transaction_aggregates.kind in ('sale','capture')
    left join transaction_aggregates as refunds
        on orders.order_id = refunds.order_id
        and orders.source_relation = refunds.source_relation
        and refunds.kind = 'refund'
    left join order_aggregates
        on orders.order_id = order_aggregates.order_id
        and orders.source_relation = order_aggregates.source_relation
    
    group by 1, 2
)

select *
from aggregated
